basics.name: Ashish Jain
basics.label: Staff Engineer, applied AI
basics.summary: I build AI systems that survive production. Staff engineer in Bangalore with 10+ years in backend engineering. Builds AI systems that survive production: real-time vision at 2M+ security events a day across 5,000+ cameras and 150+ customers, LLM pipelines, agentic tooling.

work.name: Hakimo.ai
work.summary: AI security. Real-time vision for security: the gateway and ingestion layer, edge inference, and the operator console.
highlights: Co-architected the gateway and ingestion layer behind 2M+ security events a day across 5,000+ cameras and 150+ customers
Edge inference on YOLOv11 / RF-DETR cut CPU ~60%; the in-house path avoided ~$500K of projected spend
WebSocket operator console: an NVR-style grid rendering hundreds of parallel camera streams at sub-second latency

projects.name: agent-experience

projects.name: Prentice
projects.description: A workshop for the agents you train, running on your own Mac. An agent is a folder you own: a prompt, the direction you've folded in, and a manifest. Prentice schedules it, sandboxes it, records what each run did and cost, and gives you a Desk to judge its work.

projects.name: Notes & Goals
projects.description: A calm, local-first macOS app that unifies tasks, notes, and goals as plain files in a folder you choose. No cloud, no accounts.
